description: List saved emails with optional search, type filter, pagination, and date sorting.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

limit.description: Max number of emails to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

offset.description: Number of emails to skip for pagination

search.description: Search query to filter emails by name or subject

sortByDate.description: Sort direction by date (asc or desc)

type.description: Filter by email type (e.g. html, template)

name: crm_list_emails
